title: Relocation and redesign have different cost effects
method: Synthetic monthly model: 34,000−5,000−2,000=27,000; relocation change 4,000/30,000=13.3%; final change −3,000/30,000=−10%. One-time project costs excluded.
alt: Relocation and redesign have different cost effects: Original baseline 30000 currency units/month, Relocated service 34000 currency units/month, After redesign 27000 currency units/month. Illustrative inputs.
